title: 701. Repeated String Match

examples.explanation: Repeating abcd three times gives abcdabcdabcd, which contains cdabcdab.
Two copies are needed to cover aa.
No amount of repetition introduces w.

hints: Repeat a until the built string is at least as long as b.
Check containment; if it fails, one extra copy is the only longer case worth testing.
Return -1 when even that extended string lacks b.
